turn_rows: Every owned exact TURN information row, including zero support; retain all legal action values in every panel.
river_control: In saved/restricted_river/fine_river panels every target TURN row and every opposite-seat row remains bit-identical to saved. Only target RIVER rows may change. Restricted river uses the saved profile's declared information partition; fine river uses legal fine own-card/public-board information.
full_reply_control: Original audited full fine reply may change own TURN rows too. It is a distinct final reference panel, not a fixed-turn intervention.
root_gate: Saved <= restricted-river <= fine-river <= full-fine within tolerance; three root increments telescope to the original unilateral gap. These are controlled root-value increments, not PR50 street-attributed losses.
row_gate: Finite legal menu/own-information Q values and identical chance-opponent support; no unsupported-row ranking. Do not impose per-action/per-row monotonicity on information-restricted continuation values.
tie_rule: First legal exact maximizer after summing chance times fixed-opponent reach over all histories in each information group; no approximate tie rounding.
display_order: Original PR50 group loss descending, original group index ascending; all TURN groups remain in details. Display limit does not select the assessment.
clock_scope: Thin-script entry before numerical imports through replay, analysis and writes; interpreter startup excluded.
failures: Refuse existing outputs; retain completed-profile details and partial/failure records. No favorable subset replaces the complete panel.
